package: @astryxdesign/core

# GridSpan

Grid item that spans multiple columns or rows.

**Import:** `import {GridSpan} from '@astryxdesign/core/Grid';`

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|------|------|---------|-------------|
| `columns` | `number \| 'full'` | - | Columns to span; use `'full'` to span all explicit columns. |
| `rows` | `number` | - | Rows to span. |
| `children` | `ReactNode` | - | Content. |
| `xstyle` | `StyleXStyles` | - | StyleX styles applied to the span wrapper. Must be a stylex.create() value: not an inline style object like style={{}}. |
| `className` | `string` | - | CSS class name applied to the span wrapper. |
| `style` | `React.CSSProperties` | - | Inline styles applied to the span wrapper. When `columns` or `rows` is set, its `grid-column` or `grid-row` replaces the same property in `style`. |
| `ref` | `React.Ref<HTMLDivElement>` | - | Ref forwarded to the span wrapper. |
